summary: Mercury General Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events, providing a business update and selected financial highlights. The filing includes policy counts, claims satisfaction scores, and quarterly/annual financial data such as net premiums earned and net income. No merger, acquisition, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is announced. The filing is a routine current report disclosing periodic performance metrics with no event triggering a special-situations classification.
